martie.com verified; US (California-founded) online discount store for surplus shelf-stable groceries/household goods, founded 2021 by Louise Fritjofsson and Kari Morris. Launched with $3M from Upfront Ventures (Nov 2021; Nosh calls it a 'pre-launch round'); raised $7M (Dec 2023) led by Upfront with Day One Ventures. Neither round is labeled seed/Series A in Fortune/TechCrunch/Nosh (trackers label the $7M as seed), hence unclear-round-type. Axios Pro (Apr 2024) reported it was raising a $3-4M extension; close not confirmed. Total ~$10M.
